## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- Initialised the plan-and-diary convention (root-level layout: `plans/`, `work-diary/`,
  `scripts/work-diary.py`, block appended to `CLAUDE.md`). Repo had no commits yet.
- Surveyed `~/Coding_work/riverbanks-generator` (canon, drafts, plans, diaries, maps, network)
  to work out what riverbanks.lol should be. Key facts: the board footers carry the bare domain
  (no QR, no path), so `/` is everyone's landing page; comics live in private Supabase rows with
  no stored renders; the Sunda maps are gitignored there and rebuilt by `scripts/sunda-maps.py`.
- Proposed an in-world PLURIVERS-portal site (comics reader, Third Amendment signatures, river
  delegate badges, who's who, Sunda maps, the real ideas and credits). Yan's direction: the home
  page is an interactive map of Asia's river basins, Ice Age and present, with points opening
  comic pages. For now it sits behind a Taro "under construction, check back soon" animation.
  Not building yet; more materials are coming over the next few days. Captured in
  [the draft plan](../plans/2026-10-04_river-map-holding-page.plan.md).
- Added Claude's ideas to the plan as phase 3 (**Further ideas**). Each one says how it would
  hang off Yan's map, so the two sets add up rather than compete.
- Made a **Riverbanks design system** in Claude Design
  (https://claude.ai/artifact/RWj4MTfxMmWy7LN8qttjwv), built from the generator's real values:
  the Rubik family as the comics letter it (Microbe for titles, Dirt for labels and SFX, Pixels
  for the footer band), the band ink, the act-divider colours, balloon and caption fills, and
  the `sunda-maps.py` palette. It has components for Caption, Balloon, Sfx, TitleLettering,
  BoardBand, Panel, ActDivider and MapLegend, plus the whirlpool and both Sunda maps.
- Mocked up the site on a canvas (https://claude.ai/artifact/HeTBX6VNU5ifjZYuKwNU9z): the
  Taro holding page (phone, desktop), the map home (phone, desktop) and the comic reader (phone).
  Taro, the board images and the colours for Acts Two, Three, Five and the Epilogue are
  placeholders.
- Taro, the 3D question: a three.js sketch from primitives looked like a toy. Rendered a Blender
  loop instead (`art/taro/taro_blender.py`): toon shading, Freestyle ink, a transparent 4 s loop,
  WebM 128 KB plus HEVC for Safari. Lifelike Taro needs a real mesh: Higgsfield Tripo Multiview
  from the cast portraits (9–18 credits), then a Rigify cat rig in Blender, since Higgsfield's
  auto-rig is humanoid-only. img2threejs ruled out (primitives, no quadrupeds yet).
- Added a read-only Supabase MCP for the generator's project (local config); it needs sign-in.
  It can read the database but can't download storage files.
